About this Event

Get ready to dance all night to the hottest Bollywood beats under the stars at the ultimate rooftop party!
Bollywood Nights NYC with Brown NYC presents Sundowner Soiree AT SOMEWHERE NOWHERE NYC
The city cools down. The rooftop heats up.
Join us Saturday Nov.21st , for an evening of music, dancing, and NYC skyline views at Somewhere Nowhere. Expect high-energy DJ sets, a vibrant crowd, and the atmosphere of a premium rooftop club as we dance from 5 PM to 10 PM.
Come dressed for a night out and bring your people. We’ll see you above the city.
Saturday, November 21st | 5 PM – 10 PM
Somewhere Nowhere
112 W 25th St, New York, NY 10001

MUSIC - Bollywood/ Afro /Techno / Top 40 Latino Beats

Call Kish - (848)247-8082 For More Info.

ENTRY REQUIREMENTS
Guests must be 21+ with valid government-issued ID to enter SUNDOWNER SOIREE at Somewhere Nowhere

WARDROBE GUIDELINES
Somewhere Nowhere maintains an upscale, trendy dress code.
Not permitted: shorts, athletic wear, team logos, tank tops, pool flip-flops, or slides. Final admittance is at the discretion of the door host and management.

TABLE MINIMUM SPEND
All table reservations are subject to a minimum spend, listed as the reservation “Price.” Minimum spend does not include taxes, admin fees, or gratuity. Guests may exceed the minimum spend; any overages must be settled on-site.

PAYMENT & ID POLICY
The credit card used for purchase and a matching valid photo ID must be presented upon entry by the cardholder. Failure to do so will result in denied entry. All purchases are non-refundable and non-exchangeable. Chargebacks may result in ticket cancellation and refusal of future purchases.
